description:
A world where superpowers manifest only in those who have reached the crossroads of life and death. Five years ago, a large sinkhole made numerous people, including high school student Kim Shin-gwan, into superpowers, and people set out to find the unidentified object called Repeater, which created the sinkhole. What will be the end of Kim Shin-gwan, caught up in the fight surrounding Repeater?

**Original Webtoon:**
